key_insight: GeoReplay preserves pretrained aerodynamic surrogate accuracy on source vehicles while matching fine-tuning accuracy on new vehicle classes.
engineering_relevance: It offers a way to adapt fast CFD surrogates to new vehicle designs without sacrificing their usefulness on previously learned designs.
method: Benchmark five DrivAerML-pretrained surrogates on four independent target datasets.
Replay source simulations with geometries resembling the target vehicles.
Apply replay updates only when they align with the target gradient.
evidence_signal: Across datasets differing in geometry, solver, turbulence model, and flow conditions, fine-tuning beat training from scratch in fewer than half of comparisons; GeoReplay reduced source error relative to fine-tuning in 77 of 80 settings while matching target accuracy.
watch_item: The guarantee concerns sufficiently small steps on the target training objective, not unseen-vehicle accuracy or arbitrary shifts in simulated physics.
paper_title: Measuring and Improving Transfer of Neural Surrogates for Vehicle Aerodynamics
